memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "...if you obey the Lord your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul. Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach." — Deut 30:10-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses makes a striking claim: God's commands are "not too difficult for you or beyond your reach." At first this might puzzle us. Haven't we just seen how hard-hearted and prone to wander the people were? How can obedience be described as not too difficult? The key lies in the promise just before it — God circumcises the heart. Once God does that inward work, His commands are no longer a crushing, impossible burden. They become the natural expression of a heart that loves Him.

This changes everything about how we view obedience. When our hearts are far from God, His commands feel heavy, restrictive, impossible. But when God changes our hearts and we come to love Him, obedience is transformed. What once felt like a burden becomes, increasingly, a delight.

Notice too the call to turn to God "with all your heart and with all your soul." God is not after grudging, partial, dragging-your-feet religion. He wants our whole heart engaged. And when it is, His ways cease to feel like a heavy yoke.

Jesus said it beautifully: "My yoke is easy and my burden is light" (Matt 11:30). For the heart that loves Him, walking with God is not a crushing weight but a life-giving joy. His commands are not out of reach; by His grace working in us, they become the path of freedom. If obedience feels only heavy to you, ask God to grow your love for Him — for love makes His commands light.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does obedience feel like a burden or a delight to me right now?
2. How might a deeper love for God change the way His commands feel?
3. What would it mean to turn to God with my whole heart?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when Your commands feel heavy, grow my love for You, for love makes obedience a joy. Thank You that Your yoke is easy and Your burden is light. Help me turn to You with all my heart. Amen.
